sloka: दीयताम् दीयताम् अन्नम् वासांसि विविधानि च ।इति संचोदिताः तत्र तथा चक्रुः अनेकशः ॥१-१४-१४॥
transliteration: dīyatām dīyatām annam vāsāṁsi vividhāni ca ।iti saṁcoditāḥ tatra tathā cakruḥ anekaśaḥ ॥1-14-14॥

translations.english: Men and women who had come from various countries to that sacrifice were entertained with food and drink by the magnanimous (king).
